subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation automation be supported as a core cron event schedule, as a plugin `session_end` workflow with a narrow missing SDK scheduling/event seam, or not as a new OpenClaw surface?
rationale: Current main has adjacent lifecycle and cron primitives but not the requested combined contract, and the permanent shape affects public cron config, plugin SDK boundaries, archived transcript metadata, and security review.

options.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus narrow SDK seam
options.body: Bless plugin `session_end` as the boundary signal and add only the minimal external plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed for safe archive-time workflows.

options.title: Add core cron lifecycle events
options.body: Define `schedule.kind: event` for session archive/rotation in the Gateway protocol with scoped metadata, persistence, permissions, trace output, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Document existing plugin path only
options.body: If maintainers decide current plugin hooks already cover the use case, document the supported pattern and route workflow packaging to ClawHub without adding cron event schedules.

recommendation.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Bless plugin `session_end` as the boundary signal and add only the minimal external plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed for safe archive-time workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest verified recent connection to the hook/plugin API boundary that determines whether the fix belongs in plugin SDK or core cron config.
